codeReview.finding: connectorRuntime Map and BrowserPool entries grow per workspace::portal and are only cleared via explicit cleanup/close. Long-lived worker with many workspaces can retain runtime snapshots forever.
codeReview.mitigation: TTL/evict connectorRuntime entries; call researchBrowserPool.closeAll() on SIGTERM (partially present); bound listAll().

codeReview.finding: acquire() waits up to 60s for inUse; if a caller crashes mid-withPage without finally release, context stays inUse until timeout then throws busy.
codeReview.mitigation: withSessionContext already releases in finally — keep that invariant; add watchdog that force-releases inUse > N minutes.

codeReview.finding: Worker SIGKILL (OOM/deploy) can leave Chromium + Xvfb/x11vnc orphans; connect profiles may remain until cleanupExpiredProfiles runs.
codeReview.mitigation: On worker boot: kill stale chromium for profile root; always run cleanupExpiredProfiles; use process groups / killProcessTree (already used for remote display).

codeReview.finding: Connect profile dirs removed in finally, but crash between prepareConnectProfileDir and finally can orphan dirs under profile root.
codeReview.mitigation: Boot-time sweep of connect-* dirs older than TTL (cleanupExpiredProfiles exists — verify it covers connect dirs).

codeReview.finding: Profile lock + pool inUse spin-wait could interact poorly if same portal Connect and search overlap on different locks.
codeReview.mitigation: Connect uses connect:sessionId lock; search uses pool key — generally OK. Avoid holding pool lock across Connect.

codeReview.finding: Superseding Connect cancels prior active sessions in Mongo, but in-flight worker may still finish and write connected after cancel if not checking phase often enough.
codeReview.mitigation: waitForManualLogin and transitions already re-read session; ensure every transition refuses cancelled/expired (partially done).

codeReview.finding: Many .catch(() => undefined) swallow errors on close/cleanup — good for shutdown, bad for observability if close fails silently.
codeReview.mitigation: Log close failures at warn; keep swallow on shutdown path.

codeReview.finding: processNextConnectJob still has while(true) for Connect; after architecture change success returns, but launch retry + browser launch failure paths must not loop forever without backoff.
codeReview.mitigation: Confirm loop only continues on intentional reopen; otherwise return. Add maxIterations guard.

codeReview.finding: Portal connection status and browser session status can diverge (e.g. portal connected but cookies cleared). Status UI merges both — operators can see Connected while search fails.
codeReview.mitigation: Single source of truth: availableForResearch requires sessionStatus=valid AND encrypted storage present (already mostly true in deriveConnectorDisplay).

codeReview.finding: finally removes profileDir even after successful path cleared profileDir=""; good. Failed close of Chromium may leave processes while Mongo says failed.
codeReview.mitigation: browser_close_trigger logs + killProcessTree on remote path; add boot scavenger for local Chromium.

thirtyDayRisks.risk: Portal bot wall / Akamai / captcha after cookie restore (headless or IP reputation)
thirtyDayRisks.mitigation: Headed worker, residential IP, detect security wall in AuthEvidenceEngine, alert needs_login

thirtyDayRisks.risk: Session cookie expiry / silent logout while UI still shows Connected (fresh validate skip window)
thirtyDayRisks.mitigation: Periodic health monitor validate; shorten validateFreshMs for critical portals

thirtyDayRisks.risk: Chromium crash mid-search → empty listings / false research quality
thirtyDayRisks.mitigation: Existing crash invalidate + RetryManager; ensure parallel failover covers portal

thirtyDayRisks.risk: Disk fill from screenshots/HTML auth traces/profiles
thirtyDayRisks.mitigation: Rotate tmp/auth-traces and screenshots; volume monitoring; TTL cleanup

thirtyDayRisks.risk: Mongo cold start / auth null causing intermittent 401 on research APIs
thirtyDayRisks.mitigation: Already hardened cold-start; keep connection pool warm

thirtyDayRisks.risk: Worker deploy SIGKILL leaves zombie Chromium + orphan profiles
thirtyDayRisks.mitigation: Boot scavenger; graceful SIGTERM drain; Railway memory headroom

thirtyDayRisks.risk: Connect phase / worker code drift after deploy (old worker + new phases)
thirtyDayRisks.mitigation: Deploy worker + app together; version handshake on /status

thirtyDayRisks.risk: Generic listing parsers return 0 results → research looks broken though auth OK
thirtyDayRisks.mitigation: Portal-specific extractors; treat 0 listings as degraded not auth failure

thirtyDayRisks.risk: Encryption key rotation invalidates all encrypted storageState
thirtyDayRisks.mitigation: Key versioning; dual-decrypt; force reconnect playbook

thirtyDayRisks.risk: Pool inUse stuck + concurrent research jobs starve a portal
thirtyDayRisks.mitigation: Force-release watchdog; per-portal queue depth limits
